interview.hardest_part: Bootstrapping burner automation and enough automation science on marathon costs before death-world biters arrive, using only one-second screenshot actions.
interview.likely_failure: Dying to biters with a small hand-fed base, or burning the 3-hour budget on mining, inventory, and misclicks before red science scales.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The game pauses while I plan; early points come from hand mining and crafting; spawn ore, furnaces, and a short iron-gear-red-science chain are enough for many milestones.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Death-world aggression and evolution, marathon recipe and research costs, pollution drawing attacks, one life, and slow imprecise click-to-mine and inventory control whose thinking time counts against the limit.
